newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Patrick Child said Monday's ECOFIN Council would start at 1000/0900 GMT with presentation of the Dutch Presidency's priorities and with Commission President Jacques Santer's presentation of the Commission's work programme for the next six months. It will be followed by a structured dialogue with the Eastern and Central European countries' Finance Ministers on macro-economic issues such as budgetary policy, he said.

Child said the ECOFIN Council's normal session would start at 1630/1530 GMT. He said the main points on the agenda would include the appointment of an jury for the competition to design new Euro coin, the renewal of the European Investment Bank (EIB) loans to third countries and loans to Ukraine.

In answer to a question Child said no invitation had been sent to the Commission to participate to next week's G7 meeting in Berlin, as suggested by the Belgian authorities. He added that Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy would accept such an invitation.

Spokesman Willy Helin commented on criticism notably from Belgian electricity firm Electrabel, the Flemish government and electricity companies set up by local authorities following Commissioner Karel Van Miert news conference on Wednesday.
Spokesman Elisabetta Olivi said Commissioner Mario Monti would not meet the Gibraltar delegation next week but that the Commission services would.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/46: Commission approves the registration of a third list of agricultural and food products.
- IP/97/53: Commissioner Pinheiro in East Africa: official visits to Ethiopia, Eritrea, Uganda and Kenya.
- IP/97/54: Public procurement: infringement proceedings against the United Kingdom, Germany, Belgium and Portugal.
- IP/97/55: Thailand: Commission approves humanitarian aid worth ECU two million for Burmese refugees.
- IP/97/56: Commission publishes first directory of pan European non-profit interest groups.
- Speech/97/18: Intervention by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at the invitation of Superior de Economica.
